background: Close Brothers Group is a UK merchant banking group, funded by retail and corporate deposits and lending on motor finance, asset finance, invoice finance and property development.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, at BBB on average, both on a negative outlook, and the last move was a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 17 Oct 2025, so the direction is down and further cuts are signalled. The motor finance commission issue is the background. On the figures the picture is better: CET1 of 13.8% is just under the peer median for UK mid-sized banks, leverage of 12.9% is in the top quarter, and LCR of 1012% and NSFR of 146% are both in the top quarter. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A name where the ratings, not the ratios, carry the warning.
